title: MAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution with Co-Evolutionary Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2605.10064v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-evolving language-model agents must decide what to learn next and how to preserve what they have learned across iterations. Existing systems typically carry this cross-iteration knowledge as natural-language feedback, flat episodic memory, or implicit reinforcement signals, none of which cleanly supports a frozen weak backbone at inference time. This paper introduces MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution), a framework that externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph. Its experience subgraph stores both teacher-written failure corrections and the learner's own past correct reasoning traces, which are retrieved as task-conditioned guidance for a frozen execution model. During evolution, the graph, a task-level search bandit, and a skill-level routing bandit are updated from the same reward stream, while the learner's backbone remains unchanged. translated_title: MAGE：基于协同进化知识图谱的多智能体自进化
translated_abstract: 自进化的语言模型智能体必须决定下一步学习什么，以及如何在迭代过程中保留已学到的知识。现有系统通常以自然语言反馈、扁平的情节记忆或隐式强化信号的形式承载这种跨迭代知识，但这些方式都无法在推理时良好地支持冻结的弱骨干模型。本文提出MAGE（Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution，多智能体图引导进化），一个将自我知识外化为四子图协同进化知识图谱的框架。其经验子图同时存储教师撰写的失败纠正记录和学习者自身过去的正确推理轨迹，这些内容作为任务条件化的指导被检索，供冻结的执行模型使用。在进化过程中，知识图谱、任务级搜索赌博机和技能级路由赌博机从同一奖励流中同步更新，而学习者的骨干模型保持不变。我们进一步提供了结构分析，表明……
tldr: MAGE框架将自我知识外化为经验、任务搜索与技能路由协同进化的四子图知识图谱，使冻结骨干的语言模型智能体在自进化过程中既能决定学什么、又能跨迭代保留所学知识。
en_tdlr: MAGE externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph, enabling frozen-backbone LLM agents to decide what to learn and preserve knowledge across self-evolution iterations.
